purpose: Teach: 声援/町民/趙/マメ/穂/山々/見所/７つ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「みんなで声援を送ろう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying everyone should cheer him on.
lines.style: Warm, gently sharing. Soft smile in the voice. Patient pacing—like relaying something sweet about his father. Slight lift on the final clause.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと町民まつりに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the town festival with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick attack on the opening. Bouncing energy throughout. Genuine pride—not performing, just sharing something good that happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「中国の友人、趙さんは優しい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Zhao—his Chinese friend—is such a kind person.
lines.style: Thoughtful, warm remembrance. Slight pause before the name, like she's picturing his face. Gentle tone. Trailing softly on the affection in 'kind person.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「マメに水やりして」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me how to water the plants regularly!
lines.style: Proud and earnest. Slight emphasis on 'taught me'—it matters that Dad showed him. Steady, careful pace, like he's remembering the lesson. Small bright finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ススキの穂は秋の風物詩」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me that pampas grass is the symbol of autumn.
lines.style: Soft, contemplative. Lingering on the poetic image. Unhurried pace—like savoring the thought. Quiet wonder in the tone, not explaining, just sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと富士の山々を観に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to see Mount Fuji and the mountains with Dad!
lines.style: Breathless with the bigness of it. Quick-paced, eager. Open, rounded vowels—the landscape is huge. Genuine awe, not performed. Slight catch of emotion on 'Dad.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「お祭りの見所は花火」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me the real highlight of the festival is the fireworks.
lines.style: Knowing, slightly conspiratorial—like she's sharing a secret with him. Gentle smile. Medium pace, intimate. Slight emphasis on 'fireworks' like it's the big reveal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんから絵本を７つ頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad gave me seven picture books!
lines.style: Pure joy, amazement at the number. Bright attack. Light, almost singing quality. Emphasis on 'seven'—that's a lot, that's love. Warm close, like he's still holding them.
